issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 Pharmacy issue requesting a new 0..1 MedicationKnowledge.associatedDefinition reference to MedicinalProductDefinition so MedicationKnowledge content could link to richer medicinal product definitions.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-26563-tagged git commit was found, but commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 contained MedicationKnowledge.associatedDefinition as 0..1 Reference(MedicinalProductDefinition). Commit 6422f2f98a0fcf03140c15fe93bfd6c765fc6377 then refactored MedicationKnowledge definitional content into a backbone and preserved the semantic link as MedicationKnowledge.definitional.definition 0..* Reference(MedicinalProductDefinition).
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge was later removed from the active core build. source/fhir.ini's active [resources] list omits MedicationKnowledge, commit 5a4307d78b0209f61bbc68d582c1e190b3aaee5c removed its active resource metadata, current build URLs for MedicationKnowledge return 404, and FHIR-50845 plus Pharmacy WGM minutes record the later direction to remove or deprecate MedicationKnowledge after finding homes for ongoing content.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. Editing residual source/medicationknowledge files would not change a current built artifact and restoring the old associatedDefinition name/cardinality would conflict with later refactor/removal history.
